definitions.explanation: Running at a quick pace, faster than walking but not necessarily sprinting. Often used as a command in military or gym contexts.
Doing something in a hurried manner, often skipping details. Commonly used figuratively to describe a brief or superficial treatment of a topic.

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: To run at a quick pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧そうで、{駆|か}け{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I was about to be late for the meeting time, so I headed there at a run.

⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{駆|か}け{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}します→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: Since we're short on time, I'll give a quick introduction.

examples.english: Let's take a quick look back through Japanese history.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run/gallop) + ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot/pace). Has both a literal physical meaning and a very common figurative meaning of doing something hastily or in abbreviated fashion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駆|か}け{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to rush through (sightseeing, etc.)
- {駆|か}け{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain quickly
- {駆|か}け{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to give a quick introduction
- {駆|か}け{足|あし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: a whirlwind trip

USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is used adverbially with で, meaning "in a rushed manner." This usage is extremely common in presentations, lectures, and guided tours where time is limited.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小走|こばし}り→小走り：21117_kobashiri⟧: light jog/trot — physical running only, no figurative use
- {急|いそ}ぎ{足|あし}: hurried pace — walking quickly, not running
